## My visualization
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

storms <- storms

mean_wind <- storms |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(mean_wind = mean(wind, na.rm = TRUE))

mean_wind |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = year, y = mean_wind))

storms |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_bar(mapping = aes(x = category))


```
